presidentMessage.title: President’s Message
presidentMessage.text1: Mr. Hassan Rezk, President of Association Najm, welcomes you to the association’s official platform, dedicated to the economic and professional empowerment of youth.
presidentMessage.text2: Convinced that youth are the engine of change, the association focuses on training, mentoring and continuous support to strengthen their participation in economic and social life.
presidentMessage.text3: Guided by values of respect, transparency, equality and collaboration, it develops innovative programs and expands partnerships to become a national and regional reference, inspiring young people to become the leaders of tomorrow.

aboutTeaser.title: Who We Are
aboutTeaser.text: Founded in 2020, Association Najm is a non-profit organization committed to the future of Moroccan youth. It fights unemployment, promotes socio-economic inclusion and develops educational, cultural and social programs. With an experienced team and local and international partnerships, Najm offers young people opportunities for training, support and empowerment to help them become drivers of change.

academyTeaser.title: Najm Academy for Digital Professions
academyTeaser.desc: Najm Academy trains youth in tomorrow’s digital skills. Our innovative programs prepare a new generation of digital professionals.

entrepreneurshipResults.title: Key Results – Entrepreneurship 2024
entrepreneurshipResults.note: These results demonstrate our ongoing commitment to supporting entrepreneurship and innovation in our region.

partners.title: Our Partners
partners.desc: We collaborate with renowned institutions to maximize our impact and create lasting synergies across our areas of intervention.

inauguration.title: Inauguration of Najm Academy for Digital Professions
inauguration.p1: Association Najm officially launched three professional training programs for youth: web development, graphic design and digital marketing. This initiative aims to offer a real opportunity for professional integration by acquiring skills that are in high demand on the market.
inauguration.p2: These programs are designed to meet the requirements of today’s digital world, emphasizing practice, creativity and innovation.

tracks.name: Web Development
tracks.desc: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, responsive website creation.

tracks.name: Graphic Design
tracks.desc: Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, logo and visual asset creation.

tracks.name: Digital Marketing
tracks.desc: SEO, social media, emailing, online advertising.

courseFlow.title: Training Format
courseFlow.text: Courses take place in a dynamic and participatory environment with weekly practical workshops, feedback sessions, inspiring talks and group challenges. The focus is on youth participation, collaborative work and the delivery of digital projects that address real-world needs.

firstCohort.title: A Successful First Cohort
firstCohort.text: Thanks to the engagement of trainers, partners and youth, this first cohort laid the foundation for a true dynamic of learning and transformation. The program is designed as a springboard toward a promising digital future for our youth.

objectives.p1: Association Najm seeks to make the Irchad platform a leading reference in youth economic inclusion, aligned with the spirit of the National Initiative for Human Development.
objectives.p2: The association aims to make this platform a convergence space for various youth programs, providing information and guidance, responding to young people’s aspirations and contributing to the realization of their ambitions.
objectives.p3: It focuses on creating a work environment conducive to the economic inclusion of youth by concluding agreements and partnerships with national and international institutions and bodies from academia, the economy and civil society.
objectives.p4: The association adopts good governance based on competence, establishing transparent and flexible decision-making mechanisms, including a comprehensive procedures manual for administrative and financial operations, with the goal of obtaining public-utility status and strengthening trust in its work.

items.q: How can I join the association?
items.a: Contact us via the contact form or visit our headquarters in Moulay Rachid – Sidi Othmane.

items.q: Do you support young project leaders?
items.a: Yes. Our Irchad platforms provide personalized support to structure, finance and launch projects.

items.q: Are the trainings free of charge?
items.a: Yes. They are offered free thanks to the support of our institutional partners.

items.q: Can I get funding for my project?
items.a: Some projects may receive financial support after evaluation, notably within the INDH framework.

items.q: What types of projects do you support?
items.a: Projects with strong social or economic impact: cooperatives, self-entrepreneurship, community initiatives.

items.q: Who can benefit from your services?
items.a: Youth aged 18 to 45 residing in the Moulay Rachid – Sidi Othmane area with an idea or a project to develop.

items.q: How does the support process work?
items.a: After an initial meeting, we set up a support plan including training, coaching sessions and personalized follow-up.
